result.summary: Authored docs/validation/evidence/fishing-identity-columns-2026-09-19/implementation.patch, a single unified git diff touching only godot/scripts/core/fishing.gd, godot/scripts/core/save_section_inventories.gd and godot/scripts/core/save_resource_claims_restore.gd, implementing accepted FISH-ID-R01 v2. fishing.gd: adds _effort_claim_expedition_slot (PackedInt32Array, 512, blank -1) with allocation, clear-all, per-row clear, publication in _write_effort_claim, exact-pair ownership in _refuse_effort_owner (CLAIM_PRESENT only for the exact stored slot AND generation, otherwise the existing CLAIM_STALE) and in effort_claim_row_into (both fields compared after live Directory validation and row lookup); effort_claim_expedition_ref_of now returns the STORED pair and no longer reconstructs from owner_slot_of_typed_row, returning NULL_REF only for an inactive/out-of-range row; effort_claim_payload_bytes measures the eighth array (14848); declares CANONICAL_OWNER_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2 beside the exact columns; the exact bulk API becomes EIGHT arrays throughout (constructor blank -1 and 512 shape, both record and live shape predicates, capture duplicate, private restore duplicates before publication, one payload validator with the appended blank rule and an active 0..CLAIM_COLUMN_DIRECTORY_SLOT_MAX slot check, never 512). Legacy aggregates, purge, release, Forage behaviour, habitats, stocks and every other gameplay method are untouched, and the codec preload direction is unchanged so no ownership cycle is introduced. save_section_inventories.gd: appends fishing ordinal 7 (i32/code 2, EXT_PRIMARY, count field -1) without renumbering 0..6, adds the key to NEGATIVE_ONE_FILL_KEYS and ordinal 7 to BLANK_ORDINALS_FISHING, validates it at its appended wire position via the existing slot rule in _fishing_row_refusal ([2, 4, 7]) with no live lookup, reads the fishing owner schema from Fishing.CANONICAL_OWNER_SCHEMA_VERSION (1 -> 2), moves SECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION 3 -> 4, adds SAVE_INV_SECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION and SAVE_INV_NULL_RECORD, and introduces decode_into_versioned(bytes, offset, byte_length, section_schema_version, out) with the contract's gate order (extent, byte order, section schema, null output, then the existing reader/store-count/key/owner-schema/primary/length/body flow ending in one out.copy_from); decode_into delegates with the current SECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION and no defaulted version argument or old-layout fallback. save_resource_claims_restore.gd: FISHING_I32_COLUMNS 6 -> 7, named FISH_ORDINAL_EXPEDITION_SLOT = 7, and the slot column mapped both ways in capture_fishing_into and apply_fishing; Forage paths untouched. Parent-owned tests, registry metadata, generated declarations, ledger, docs and evidence are not modified, and no build, test or CI step is claimed or performed.
